programme.title: Terminator 2: Sudnji dan, film
programme.desc: Nastavak Terminatora iz 1984. godine, u kojem se nepobjedivi kibor ponovno vraća, ali ovaj put programiran da spasi Johna Connora. 21. je stoljeće. Svijetom nakon nuklearne katastrofe vladaju strojevi i samo jedan čovjek može utjecati na promjene: Connor. On je odabaran da vodi ljudski pokret otpora protiv robota i novonastalog sustava. Robot kiborg programiran da uništava - zbog čega je i dobio ime Terminator (Arnold Schwarzenegger) bio je prije deset godina poslan kako bi buduću Johnovu majku (Linda Hamilton) ubio prije nego što rodi. No misija je propala i John je rođen... John je sada buntovni tinejdžer. Samo Sarah Connor, njegova majka, zna za postojanje gotovo neuništivih Terminatora. No nitko joj ne vjeruje, a ono o čemu govori proglašavaju halucinacijama. Zbog toga je i zatvorena u bolnicu za mentalne bolesnike.

programme.title: Smrtonosna zona, film
programme.desc: Zloglasni zatvor Alcatraz ponovno je otvoren. Ljutit zatvorski birokrat Donny (Morris Chesnut) okupio je postrojbu koja će ući u tvrđavu i natjerati zatvorenika Lestera (Bruce Weitz) koji čeka smrtnu kaznu da otkrije gdje je skrio 200 milijuna dolara u zlatu. Zatvorenik Nick (Ja Rule) mora pomoći tajnom agentu FBI-a Saschi (Steven Seagal) da zaustavi napadače. Alcatraz postaje pravo bojno polje. Film je dvostruko nominiran za nagradu Taurus 2003. godine.

programme.title: Lakeview Terrace, film
programme.desc: U Lakeview Terraceu mladi se par (Patrick Wilson i Kerry Washington) upravo uselio u svoj kalifornijski dom iz snova. Postaju meta prvog susjeda koji ne odobrava međurasni odnos. Strogi samohrani otac, nabrijani losandželeski policajac (Samuel L. Jackson) sebe je proglasio čuvarom susjedstva. Njegove noćne ophodnje i pretjerano budne oči nekima su utjeha, ali za mladi par to postaje sve veće šikaniranje. Uporno uplitanje u njihov život poprima tragičan zaokret nakon što par odluči uzvratiti.

programme.title: Dvije sestre za kralja, film
programme.desc: Priča o sestrama koje su postale žrtve najokrutnijeg ljubavnika svih vremena. U doba kada je tiranija bila omiljena vrsta vladavine, jedan se moćni čovjek poigrao sa životom dviju sestara. Jedna se zaljubila a druga je željela vlast. Henrik VIII želio je nasljednika a njegova lako zaljubljiva narav primoravala ga je na najgnusnije zločine. Doba u kojem se vlastite žene slalo na vješala prikazano na posve neobičan način...

programme.title: Opasnost iz dubine, film
programme.desc: U napetom trileru OPASNOST IZ DUBINE, dok Nancy (Blake Lively) surfa na osamljenoj plaži, nađe se usred hranilišta velike bijele psine. Iako je zaglavila samo 180 metara od obale, preživljavanje će testirati njezinu snagu volje do krajnosti i zahtijevati svu njezinu ingenioznost, snalažljivost i hrabrost.

programme.title: Ljudi u crnom: Globalna prijetnja, film
programme.desc: Ljudi u crnom proširili su se na cijeli svijet, ali isto vrijedi i za svemirsku gamad. A da bi nas čuvali, odlikovani agent H (Chris Hemsworth) i odlučna novakinja M (Tessa Thompson) udruženi su u partnerstvo - malo vjerojatan par koji bi možda mogao funkcionirati. Kad se suoče s novom izvanzemaljskom prijetnjom koja može poprimiti oblik bilo koga, uključujući agente MIB-ja, moraju udružiti snage u globalnoj pustolovini kako bi spasili agenciju, a na kraju i svijet.

programme.title: Pripravnici, film
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) i Nick (Owen Wilson) trgovci su čije je karijere osujetio digitalni svijet. Kako bi dokazali da nisu zastarjeli, prkose izgledima i domognu se traženog pripravništva u „Googleu, zajedno sa skupinom briljantnih studenata. Ali ulazak u ovu utopiju samo je polovica bitke. Sada se moraju natjecati s grupom najelitnijih, tehnički obrazovanih genijalaca u zemlji kako bi dokazali da je nužda uistinu majka domišljatosti.

programme.title: Fantômas, film
programme.desc: Najbolji muškarci Francuske, hrabri novinar i iznimno energični policajac, bacaju se u potragu za zagonetnim zločinačkim veleumom... "Fantomas" je 1964. bio odgovor Francuske na fenomen Jamesa Bonda koji je pomeo svijet u to doba. Ovo je prvi film iz trilogije, a Fantômas je postao silno uspješan u Europi, Sovjetskom Savezu i Japanu. Uspio je i u SAD-u gdje dan-danas postoje web-stranice obožavatelja. Opći ton filmova lakši je od originalnih romana Fantômas koje su napisali Pierre Souvestre i Marcel Allain.

programme.title: Ghost Rider, film
programme.desc: Kad motociklist kaskader ponudi svoju dušu Mefistofelesu kako bi spasio živote onih koje najviše voli, prisiljen je biti domaćin moćnom natprirodnom biću čije lice, koje izgleda kao lubanja u plamenu, ulijeva strah u kosti njegovim neprijateljima. Ova cjelovečernja filmska inačica nastala je po dugogodišnjoj seriji stripova. Danju je Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) jedan od najboljih svjetskih kaskadera, ali kad sunce zađe i kad se nađe među zlim silama, junak koji odolijeva smrti nestaje u plamenu i postaje neuništivi antijunak na motociklu, u svijetu poznat kao Ghost Rider.

programme.title: Ghost Rider, film
programme.desc: Kad motociklist kaskader ponudi svoju dušu Mefistofelesu kako bi spasio živote onih koje najviše voli, prisiljen je biti domaćin moćnom natprirodnom biću čije lice, koje izgleda kao lubanja u plamenu, ulijeva strah u kosti njegovim neprijateljima. Danju je Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) jedan od najboljih svjetskih kaskadera, ali kad sunce zađe i kad se nađe među zlim silama, junak koji odolijeva smrti nestaje u plamenu i postaje neuništivi antijunak na motociklu, u svijetu poznat kao Ghost Rider.

programme.title: Knjižničar 2: Potraga za blagom kralja Solomona, TV film
programme.desc: Knjižničar i pustolov Flynn Carsen kao mali slušao je priče o afričkim pustolovinama koje mu je prije spavanja čitao njegov voljeni otac. Flynn sada shvaća da je u tim pričama bio skriven ključ za otkrivanje legendarnih rudnika kralja Salomona i kreće u potragu. Njegovi su pomagači arheologinja Emily Davenport i plemenski ratnik Jomo, a njihove opasne i beskrupulozne protivnike predvodi general Samir... Nakon uspjeha TV filma "Knjižničar: Potraga za oštricom" (2004), dio njegova kreativnog tima odlučio se za nastavak koji je realiziran dvije godine kasnije. Nositelj naslovne uloge Noah Wyle (najpoznatiji po ulozi doktora Johna Cartera u TV seriji Hitna služba) u novom je projektu postao i jedan od producenata, kao i autor izvornog scenarija David N. Titcher. Koncepcija je ista te svojim spojem egzotične pustolovine i arheologije, fantastike i humora, očito slijedi obrazac Lucasova Indiane Jonesa, s tim da lijepu Sonyu Walger u nastavku nasljeđuje jednako lijepa Gabrielle Anwar (najpoznatija kao plesna partnerica Al Pacina u američkom remakeu talijanskog hita Miris žene), dok je glavni negativac umjesto Kylea MacLachlana Erick Avari (Planet majmuna). Spomenimo i da je 2008. snimljen još jedan nastavak - The Librarian: The Curse of the Judas Chalice.

programme.title: Torrente 3: Zaštitnik, film
programme.desc: Beskompromisna europska povjerenica za ekologiju Giannina Ricci (Y. Scio) najavila je dolazak u Španjolsku i objavljivanje štetnih postupaka velike multinacionalne kompanije Petronosa. Budući da će time biti ugroženi interesi moćnoga kapitala, sigurnosna procjena upozorila je na mogućnost ugrožavanja gošćina života. Za osiguranje je angažiran osebujan agent Jose Luis Torrente (S. Segura) čije metode ne slijede nijedan poznati model, ali su nekim čudom stopostotno uspješne... El Protector je naslov trećega nastavka serijala o doživljajima nespretnoga, ali čudom učinkovitoga španjolskog agenta Josea Luisa Torrentea, koji je kao i prethodna dva sa sobom u glavnoj ulozi scenaristički osmislio, producirao i režirao popularni španjolski komičar Santiago Segura (Misija Marbella, Dijete dvaju očeva). Snimljen je 2005. godine, sedam godina nakon uspješnoga prvijenca koji je autoru donio npr. i španjolskoga Oscara, nagradu Goya. Španjolsko gledateljstvo koje Torrentea obožava, bilo je razveseljeno brojnim posvetama u obliku pojava poznatih javnih osoba u ulogama "statista sa zadatkom", od nogometaša Figoa do pjevača Carlosa Iglesiasa i drugih. Hrvatski će gledatelji, posebice stariji, među glumcima zamijetiti, npr. nekoć popularne Fabija Testija ili Tonyja Leblanca.

programme.title: London Calling, film

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial - a predator - that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia - a Tiger Quoll - smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray’s cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett’s tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he’s got some good news and bad news. Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon - Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie - Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia’s skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle - Australia’s largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican - Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds - Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl - Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture - Africa’s plains are scanned by vultures, nature’s cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel - Australia’s smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos’ the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Finally for this series, we are exploring the world of nocturnal animals—creatures adapted to thrive in darkness. Escaping predators, avoiding heat, and sharing resources, they emerge as night falls. Join porcupines, raccoons, mice, cats, foxes, and more on their nightly journey. From raccoons with sensitive touch to mice surviving in teams, each is a master of the night. Across continents, these animals—like the fruit-loving porcupine—showcase fear, excitement, and survival in the shadows.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: Na velegradskim krovovima
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures: our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA’s Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: The invention of paper seems straightforward. Although writing has been around for a long time, paper hasn't. In fact, putting thoughts down in written form wasn't always easy or practical. Early people discovered that they could make simple drawings on the walls of caves, which was a great place for recording thoughts, but not very portable. Earlier forms were bamboo, made by the Chinese and we have all heard of Papyrus, which actually was not the first type of paper. True paper - made from various fibers much like today, is credited to Han Dynasty official Cai Lun in 105 AD, though there's evidence of use 100-200 years' earlier. Paper used to be extremely expensive - it was all hand made and used only by kings' advisers. In the 14th century man started making paper from cloth, as the Black Death left so many clothes behind. That made paper cheap. But another question arose, how do we put things on paper? The pen has made some revolutionary changes. Often - because those having the luxury of being able to write - ended up annoyed with the ink stains it left behind. The feather pen wasn’t ‘all that’! The humble ballpoint pen was invented when someone thought of placing a ball inside a tube filled with ink. Nowadays, paper brings us another issue: it is one of the largest contributor to greenhouse gasses and other pollutants - about 10% of all greenhouse gasses - which is three times more than the aviation industry! So now we have E-paper. The one and only non-paper... paper.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: The invention of ‘waves’ - as in radio waves or electro-magnetic fields - has led to many great inventions. Radio waves transmit music, conversations, pictures or data invisibly through the air, over thousands of miles - it happens every day in thousands of different ways. Even though radio waves are invisible and completely undetectable to humans, they have totally changed society. Whether we are talking about a cell phone, a microwave oven, our TV’s, RADAR systems or any one of the thousands of other wireless technologies, all of them use radio waves to communicate. But what are radio waves? Radio waves are a force that is created when you combine magnetism and electricity: so called electromagnetism. How did we discover all this? Many men were involved: In the 18th century, Luigi Galvani made frog legs twist; Benjamin Franklin used a kite and a key during a thunderstorm; in the 19th century Hans Christian Oersted saw a needle move every time he switched on the electricity; and the list of surprising discoveries goes on… the microwave oven discovered through a rapidly melting chocolate bar and even the X-ray. EM waves travel through everything. They can detect and scan - even our most intimate parts. What’s next? Improving our understanding of the human brain. Yes, EM waves see all.

programme.title: Ukradena remek djela
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Who came up with the idea of canned food? It began with a battle between French and British armies, two centuries ago. Napoleon Bonaparte faced many problems with his goal to dominate Europe, one of which was feeding a large and sprawling army. In 1809 Napoleon held a contest, with a prize of 12,000 francs for the person who could come up with the most innovative method of preserving food. The winner was Nicolas François Appert who submitted a method of boiling and sealing food in glass bottles. Well if the French were going to travel farther and farther, the British needed to invent something as well: canning. However, opening the cans was quite a challenge - soldiers worked with stones and bayonets and it was only 30 years later that someone designed the first can opener! Although cans travel much easier across a battlefield, for decades they would not only mysteriously explode, but would also cause the harshest diseases. But how could the scientists of those days know? It wasn't until 50 years after Appert that Louis Pasteur discovered why canning (generally) worked so well. By testing the influence of air on broths, he did away with the idea that things spoiled ‘spontaneously’ and launched his ‘germ theory’. Even though canned foods became safer, they didn’t taste any better. The ultra-lengthy boiling process was obviated with the help of pressure-cooking. And now, the future brings ‘zapped’ canned food, something called ‘raddaperization’. Does the name ring a bell?

programme.desc: In this sobering yet thrilling instalment of Desperate Hours our special focus on Geological Disasters. Now most natural disasters, including volcanoes and earthquakes are of course geological disasters. But, avalanches, landslides, blizzards and heatwaves. They don’t - usually - causes fatalities in the tens of thousands. Do they? Don’t be lulled into a false sense of security. While casualty counts might be lower, geological disturbances like landslides and heat waves can cause their fair share of misery. A heat wave for instance, can be one of nature’s silent killers. India is justifiably renowned for its hot climate, but the heat wave that scorched India in the middle of this decade was something else. For two miserable weeks. In New Delhi, the 45 degree heat actually started melting roads. Ours is a dangerous world, where geological mishaps - avalanches, landslides, heat waves, sinkholes and blizzards, can spell disaster, almost as much as the big cataclysms such as earthquakes, volcanoes and tidal waves. It’s enough to make you want to purchase that one way ticket to Mars.

programme.title: Putovanja kroz povijest
programme.desc: Marvel at the site of America’s most famous water dam. We’ll learn about how the Hoover Dam was built, why it’s necessary, and take a behind the scenes look at its inner workings.

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it’s maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature’s heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let’s look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray’s cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett’s tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Putovanja po Indiji
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it. The most significant building to people of the Sikh faith, it is open to people of all faiths. We witness the celebration of the changing of the guard before heading into the mountains for a visit to the British influenced town of Shimla. Journeys then heads further north for look at the resort area of Manali.

programme.title: Putovanja po Indiji
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world. Bill gets the inside scoop on this strange land and is doubly surprised by his local guide.

programme.title: Putovanja po Africi
programme.desc: If there ever was a lost wildlife gem, it would be Mikumi. Here many of the Big Twelve live their lives against the backdrop of one of the most scenic parks in Africa. Bill takes a break from the wildlife safari to investigate the huge salt works at the edge of the park and how it may impact future conservation.

programme.title: Putovanja po Africi
programme.desc: South Africa has many different tribal groups and ethnic people, but none have a more fascinating story than the Zulu. These were once the most feared warriors in all of Africa and they have fiercely held onto that culture. They’re also dedicated conservationists and we see first-hand the wildlife sanctuaries they’ve created. This is a proud people with a unique history, and we get to share that with them.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Baccarat, legenda o kristalu
programme.desc: This film retraces 250 years of French art de vivre from Royal Courts to today’s finest Crystal works found in the most prestigious settings commissioned by leading figures and celebrities. The saga started in Lorraine a region known for its tradition in glassmaking where the manufacture shaped its unrivaled know-how and created its iconic pieces. Today, to shape its brand into the XXIst century with intact splendor and craft, the world’s most celebrated crystal maker has developed fruitful collaboration with international designers, such as Philippe Starck.

programme.title: Opažanje i stvarnost: Znanost magije
programme.desc: Our film follows researchers who are bringing magicians’ tricks into the laboratory. With impossible magic, amazing facts, and opportunities for viewers to participate in the magic tricks, this extraordinary exploration peeks behind the curtain into a fascinating world where ancient magic meets modern science. Magician Julie Eng not only mystifies us with magic, she also takes us to Montreal’s McGill University to meet Jay Olson who is using card tricks to study consciousness. His research also includes an MRI machine that can apparently not only read minds, but also manipulate thoughts. In the US we meet with professor Anthony Barnhart. He’s a magician turned scientist who is using magic principles to investigate why we sometimes don’t see what’s right under our noses. We also meet Professor Amory Danek who is using the conjuror’s craft to study creativity and problem solving.Professor Ronald Rensink at the University of British Columbia discovered how small distractions can blind drivers to obvious dangers. programme.title: Mbudha, stopama čimpanza
programme.desc: In the northeast corner of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, there remains a red zone, designated as such since the second war of the Congo, (1998-2002), where no foreigners have entered since 1999. The biologist Anne Laudisoit and a Congolese scientists team embark upon a scientific exploration to identify species that dwell in one of the last virgin territories of Central Africa. In the lush yet inaccessible valleys of the Blue Mountains, an amazing startling bio-diversity thrives. It is said that there are even chimpanzees.

programme.title: Cheetah
programme.desc: The Canary Islands are sheltered by a mild climate, protected from any extremes of weather. But high up on the towering mountains, the conditions can turn treacherous. In winter, water is released by high altitude storms and fertilized by nutrients washed from the soil. As this drains into the sea the soupy waters around the islands attract a huge variety of life, draw in in from the vast Atlantic Ocean. Many whale and dolphin species congregate in these waters, but above all Short-finned pilot whales are found here in the vast numbers.Isora is the leader and matriarch of one of the largest resident pilot whale pods between Tenerife and La Gomera and we document her activities over a one year period. Several females and their offspring form the hard-core of this close-knit society where all the main family members are related to the mother. Males in the pod also play a role, but not in reproduction, as they are blood relatives. With their vow of chastity, they ensure the protection of newborns and juveniles - a long-term investment which is crucial for pod survival.Physical contact is important for the whales and the film reveals moving and rarely-seen interaction between the older

programme.title: Osiromašeni uranij - izuzetni ubojica
programme.desc: More than 50 countries now possess weapons based on depleted uranium (DU). Experimentation has been rife, and the consequences for civilians and the military alike have been dramatic. This investigation compares and contrasts the arguments of those who defend and attack a technology that is highly toxic. For 20 years, scientists, doctors, veterans and activists have denounced the use of DU. Against them are the arms industry lobbyists and nuclear authorities who continue to minimise the risks. Through archive documents, interviews and in situ investigations, accompanied by key witnesses (victims, experts...) we aim to present a clearer picture of the issues and stakes linked to the use of DU. Quick-paced, with a sense of urgency, the film underlines the essential background and conflicting viewpoints, enabling viewers to make up their own minds about a subject that concerns us all.

programme.title: Leopardove nove pjege
programme.desc: The Leopard’s New Spots is a documentary film about one man’s mission to halt the alarming decline in southern Africa’s leopard populations due to a widespread skin trade. Traditionally, only the Zulu royals have been allowed to wear leopard skins. However, in the last three decades the Shembe Church, a four million strong religious group, has adopted the skins into their ceremonial costume. The demand for leopard skins is now astronomical. Because the use of skins is so wide spread and culturally entrenched, law enforcement seems helpless to police this trade in a protected species. It has become, in one researchers words, 'a major conservation blind spot’. Leopard researcher Tristan Dickerson believes that you can’t save the leopard without the support of the Shembe people. The film follows Dickerson as he travels from the heart of leopard country to the heart of Shembe and Zulu culture in an effort to discover a solution that benefits all parties. His best solution turns out to be fake fur. Bad fakes are commonly used by church members while they save for the expensive real thing. programme.title: U oceanu spoznaja
programme.desc: Oko 71% površine našega planeta prekriveno je vodom, a od toga oko 97% otpada na oceane. U moru usto nastaje najveći dio kisika koji udišemo. Rad na boljem poznavanju i očuvanju morskog okoliša stoga je od temeljne važnosti za naš opstanak. Film prati znanstvenike angažirane na pet projekata u sklopu društveno-ekološkog programa naftne kompanije Petrobras, koji obuhvaća zaštitu morskih kornjača, morskih krava, dupina, koralja i albatrosa.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom, film
programme.desc: Jenny Taylor (Amanda Bynes) našla je svojeg idealnog muškarca za kojeg je sigurna da će je potpuno osvojiti. No, postoji jedan problem. Njen idealan muškarac je Jason Masters (Chris Carmack), najveća rock-zvijezda na svijetu. Nadajući se da će dobiti priliku i približiti se svojem idolu, Jenny se zapošljava u njegovom omiljenom karipskom odmaralištu, St. Luchasu, zajedno s Ryanom (Jonathan Bennett). Dok joj Ryan pomaže dajući joj savjete od kojih će joj pomoći da preživi na otoku, Ryanov prijatelj mu daje savjete kako se udvarati Jenny. Ryan se potpuno promijeni, no kada ga Jenny vidi, govori samo o Jasonu. Ryan se loše osjeća i odluči otići, no zaustavi auto nasred puta, iziđe i poljubi je. Kaže joj da su stvoreni jedno za drugo, no Jenny mu kaže da su samo prijatelji. Kada to čuje, grozno se osjeća te nju ostavi na cesti, a on uđe u auto i kaže da se vraća kući. Jenny postane žao te se odluči ispričati. Ona je još na drugoj strani otoka kada se Ryan počne spremati za povratak kući. U tom se trenutku pročuje vijest da će snažna oluja pogoditi St. Luchas. Jenny ne zna što se sprema, a Ryan se požuri kako bi je spasio. Kada Jason za vrijeme oluje završi u moru, Jenny skoči za njim kako bi ga spasila te se oboje nađu na naoko pustom tropskom otoku. Jenny shvati da su samo nekoliko kilometara udaljeni od odmarališta, no umjesto da Jasonu kaže istinu, ona ga ostavi u uvjerenju da su se nasukali kako bi ga natjerala da se zaljubi u nju. Kada otkrije njezin plan, Jennyna se suparnica Alexis (Jamie-Lynn Discala) odluči pretvarati da se i ona nasukala. Jennyn se plan počne raspadati te shvati da joj je savršena ljubav cijelo vrijeme pred nosom.

Ali dar je smrtonosan, Scoper poludi do svoje 29-e godine. On sada ima 28. Joshua i njegov mentor rade za vladu, u zamjenu za lijek. Za vrijeme jedne misije upoznaje neuvježbanu Scopericu, Annu, u koju se odmah zaljubi. Ali vlada to ne želi dopustiti, te oni smišljaju plan kako bi nestali, u nadi da će početi novi, zajednički život, ali su uskoro otkriveni i razdvojeni. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz djetinjstva, Joshua je prisiljen otkriti istinu o svojim sposobnostima, korupciji koja ga okružuje i moći koju ima za spašavanje budućnosti.

programme.title: Gorko/slatko, film
programme.desc: „Gorko/slatko“ romantična je komedija vođena karakterizacijom likova koje postavlja u neobične, netipične situacije. Film je priča o američkom stručnjaku za kavu Brianu Chandleru (Kip Pardue) koji naizgled ima savršen život. No stvari se počnu mijenjati kada ga njegov šef, odmetnuti magnat i proizvođač kave Calvert Jenkins (James Brolin) pošalje na Tajland na inspekciju usjeva. Pri dolasku Brian upoznaje Tichu (Mamee Nakprasit), bankošku direktoricu koja se brine za glamuroznu, darovitu divu, Tajlanđanku Tatu Young (Tata Young). Budući da je uvijek zaposlena, Ticha je već odavno odustala od potrage za pravom ljubavi. Na nagovor roditelja, uzgajivača kave, Nee i Surapong (Viyada Umarin i Sompop Benjadhikul) koji se nadaju da će Brian kupiti kavu kod njih i spasiti selo od okrutnog posrednika Kanga (Arun Whasadeewong), Ticha pristaje dovesti Briana na plantaže kave u Južni Krabi i pomiriti se sa svojom prošlosti. Zanimljive dodatne zaplete u priči donose i Tichina vatrena sestra Mint (Pakaramai Potranan) i njezin naočit dečko boksač Komane (Akara Amatayakul), njezina pristupačna i otvorena najbolja prijateljica Mook (Kalorin Nemayothin) i njezin urnebesno smiješan dečko Austrijanac Werner (Spencer Garrett), kao i Brianova prelijepa zaručnica Amanda (Laura Sorenson). Brian i Ticha "ista su strana različitih medalja" i zato se neprestano sudaraju. No kad ih putovanje odvede iz velegradske vreve Bangkoka u Krabi, pitoreskni krš okružen plantažama kave, i Biran i Tiha počinju shvaćati da su stvoreni jedno za drugo.

programme.title: Savršena žena, film
programme.desc: U prometnoj nesreći strada mladi Ruben Tyman, kojem liječnik Robert Steward, koji se slučajno našao na mjestu zbivanja, ne uspijeva pomoći, pa mladić premine. U bolnici Rubenova privlačna sestra Leah dočuje da je muževni dr. Steward prvo pomogao drugoj žrtvi nesreće i zbog toga zaključi da je odgovoran za smrt njezina brata, s kojim je bila u neobičnom emocionalnom odnosu, zapravo opsesivno zaljubljena. Još istog dana Leah krišom skine drugu žrtvu nesreće s aparata za održavanje života, a godinu kasnije uda se za dr. Stewarda, s namjerom da se osveti njemu i njegovim najbližima... "Savršena supruga" interesantan je triler redatelja Dona E. Faunt LeRoya, koji je karijeru započeo kao snimateljski pomoćnik, potom je postao direktor fotografije, a onda i redatelj. Don E. Faunt LeRoy uglavnom radi u televizijskim produkcijama, a na jednoj takvoj, trećoj sezoni glasovite serije Sjever i Jug, upoznao je Lesley-Anne Down koja mu je postala suprugom. Lesley-Anne Down imala je jednu od glavnih uloga u Sjeveru i Jugu, a u "Savršenoj supruzi" tumači drugu glavnu žensku ulogu. U glavnim su ulogama Perry King (The Day After Tomorrow) i Shannon Sturges, unuka kultnog hollywoodskog filmaša Prestona Sturgesa, 1996. u izboru magazina People izabrana među 50 najljepših na svijetu.

programme.desc: Tko kaže da morate pobijediti, da biste bili prvak? Slava Kolotiloff, učitelj iz uspavanog priobalnog grada po nazivu "Prsti" dolazi osvojiti Moskvu s rukopisom svoje prve novele. Umjesto toga, posve slučajno, osvaja srce prelijepe Nadie (Milla Jovovich). Dok se njihovo vjenčanje približava, Slava treba prekinuti njegov posao i privesti kraju nedovršene poslove u "Prstima" prije povratka u Moskvu, gdje će početi novi život sa svojom mladenkom. Ali uslijed više bizarnih okolnosti, ne može otići, ali se organiziranje vjenčanja ipak nastavlja, a Nadia se mora oduprijeti pažnji bivšeg dečka Danya, koji je spreman učiniti sve što je potrebno, kako bi je ponovo osvojio.

programme.title: Jennyno vjenčanje, film

programme.title: Satin, film
programme.desc: Pjevač Jack Satin bez novca je i bez posla, ali opsjednut je težnjom za slavom. Kada je prisiljen napustiti Las Vegas, spakira stvari u stari Cadillac i zaputi se prema Atlantic Cityju. Ubrzo mu se pokvari auto zbog čega zapne u gradiću Lost Springsu. Ondje upozna džez-legendu Doca Bishopa koji mu pomogne u nevolji s automobilom. Iako je daleko od svjetla pozornice, Jack se počinje osjećati kao kod kuće u malom gradiću. Nakon što upozna zgodnu konobaricu Lauren Wells, Jack uvidi da je život mnogo više od slave i bogatstva.

programme.title: Ponoć u plavoj travi, film
programme.desc: Agent FBI-a i službenik države Floride udružuju se kako bi istražili niz neriješenih slučajeva ubojstava.

programme.title: U raljama zvijeri, film
programme.desc: Jake Hopper bio je prije deset godina agent CIA-e stacioniran u Tajlandu. Sada vodi vlastitu osiguravateljsku kompaniju u SAD-u, no netko je oteo njegovu kćer Jessicu dok je s prijateljicom, kćeri američkog senatora, turistički boravila u Tajlandu. Otmicu su navodno izveli islamski fundamentalisti pa američka vlada šalje svoje ljude u Tajland da oslobode djevojke. Jake također odlazi u Tajland i tamo uz pomoć starog prijatelja Suntija, sad budističkog svećenika, pokušava ući u trag otmičarima te spasiti kćer i njezinu prijateljicu. Jake pomaže i mlada i dražesna Lulu te otkrije da otmičari nisu islamisti nego odmetnuti general Jantapan... Nekadašnja velika zvijezda akcijskog žanra Steve Seagal (Iznad zakona, Pod opsadom 1 i 2) više nije u središtu pozornosti, ali njegovi filmovi još itekako privlače pozornost ljubitelja akcijskih filmova. "Belly of the Beast" snimio je prema vlasitoj priči u Hong Kongu, u režiji produktivnog Siu-Tung Chinga, dobro poznatog hongkonškog sineasta, posebno istaknutog kao koreografa akcijskih prizora, koji je surađivao i s takvim velikanima kao što su Hark Tsui i Zhimou Yang. "Belly of the Beast" svakako će zadovoljiti poklonike akcijsko-borilačkog filma, jer riječ je kompaktnom, izvrsno produciranom i napetom ostvarenju zanimljive priče i pouzdanih glumačkih izvedbi.

programme.title: Ubojstvo predsjednika srednje škole, film
programme.desc: U katoličkoj srednjoj školi, popularna djevojka se udružuje s novinskim izvjestiteljem drugog razreda kako bi istražili slučaj ukradenih SAT ispita. Nakon što dvojac otkrije osumnjičenike, otkriva se veća zavjera.

programme.title: Ubojstvo predsjednika srednje škole, film
programme.desc: U katoličkoj srednjoj školi, popularna djevojka se udružuje s novinskim izvjestiteljem drugog razreda kako bi istražili slučaj ukradenih SAT ispita. Nakon što dvojac otkrije osumnjičenike, otkriva se veća zavjera.

programme.title: Svemirski grijeh, film
programme.desc: Sedam elitnih vojnika pokreću preventivni napad protiv novootkrivene civilizacije vanzemaljaca, u nadi da će okončati međuzvjezdani rat prije nego što počne.

programme.title: Pirati s velikog slanog jezera, film
programme.desc: Kirk Redgrave je bedasti sanjar koji živi s majkom, sve dok ga njeno neodobravanje njegovog tajnog piratskog života ne prisili na iseljenje. Prihvatio je simpatičnog gubitnika Flinta kao prvog cimera, te zajedno krenu na plovidbu jezerom Great Salt, zastajući uz obalu kako bi pokrali lakovjerne turiste i prouzročili nevolje svim 'ljudima s kopna' koji im se nađu na putu. Kada naiđu na uistinu ukletu mapu s blagom, ove pirate uskoro počne proganjati grupa ekscentričnih tipova, u potrazi za nezamislivim bogatstvom. Zabavniji od ispijene boce ruma, PIRATI JEZERA GREAT SALT je neobična priča o dva neshvaćena mladića, koji otkrivaju pravo prijateljstvo dok proživljavaju njihove najluđe fantazije.

programme.title: Visina, film
programme.desc: FBI agentici su ponuđeni milijuni kako bi pomogla kradljivcu pobjeći iz otetog aviona.

programme.title: Izgubljeno blago Jesseja Jamesa, film
programme.desc: Grupa djece iz zaleđa Missourija utrkuje se kako bi riješili sto godina staru tajnu i spasili svoje prijatelje u ovoj obiteljskoj akcijskoj avanturi. Proganjani duboko u drevne špilje, moraju pobjeći tragačima za blagom koji su im za petama ili će biti zauvijek izgubljeni.

programme.title: Kako se piše ljubav, film
programme.desc: Keith Michaels (Hugh Grant) nekoć je bio nagrađivani holivudski scenarist, no danas je u dugovima i bez inspiracije. Stoga je primoran prihvatiti posao gostujućeg predavača na malom koledžu. Iako se isprva nada da će u posao uložiti minimalan trud kako bi se mogao posvetiti svojem novom scenariju, Keith se sve više uključuje u živote svojih studenata među kojima je Holly (Marisa Tomei), samohrana majka koja nastoji okrenuti novu stranicu u životu.

programme.title: Klik - za savršen život, film
programme.desc: Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) oženjen je prekrasnom Donnom (Kate Beckinsale); imaju dvoje sjajne djece koju on i ne viđa jer sate i sate provpdi u svojoj tvrtki. U potrazi za savršenim daljinskim upravljačem, Michael slučajno uđe u prostoriju osoblja Bed, Bath & Beyond, gdje mu ekscentrični zaposlenik (Christopher Walken) proda eksperimentalni gadget koji će mu zajamčeno promijeniti život. Michael uskoro može uključiti i isključiti svaki uređaj samo jednim klikom na upravljaču. Ali uređaj ima i druge, uzbudljivije mogućnosti. Nekako uspijeva stišati lajanje psa – i još nevjerojatnije – premotati preko još jedne svađe sa suprugom. Michael ubrzo postane ovisan o uređaju. Ali prije nego što se uspije snaći, upravljač počne programirati njega...

programme.title: Priča o Jane Austen, film
programme.desc: Biografska romantična drama o Jane Austen i mladom Ircu prije nego što je postala slavna spisateljica. Jane je mlađa kći svećenika Georga Austena i obitelj traži odgovarajućeg muškarca za njezina muža. Ona je više zainteresirana za pisanje nego za udaju što izaziva majčino zgražanje, ali i očev ponos. Jedan od mogućih kandidata je Thomas Lefroy, advokat pred kojim je karijera... Film se djelomično temelji na knjizi Jona Huntera Specea "Becoming Jane Austen", koji je bio i konzultant za povijest.

programme.title: Bračne svađe, film
programme.desc: Priča o dva bračna para čiji se sinovi potuku u školi zbog čega se roditelji odluče sastati, porazgovarati i intervenirati. No, umjesto da taj mali incident riješe civilizirano, dogodi se upravo suprotno! Spletom okolnosti između roditelja dođe do još jednog incidenta, ali malo većih razmjera.

programme.title: Tata od formata, film
programme.desc: "Tata od formata" prikazuje manje eksponiranu stranu Adama Sandlera. Dok su njegovi rani nastupi pamćeni kao grubi, drski i bizarni, u ovoj sjajnoj obiteljskoj komediji o neobičnom posvajanju iznimno talentirani Sandler ima priliku pokazati i nježnije, brižnije lice. Sonny Koufax (Adam Sandler) je tridesetogodišnjak s manjkom ambicija i viškom slobodnog vremena. Njegova djevojka Vanessa (Kristy Swanson) čvrsto je naumila raskinuti vezu, a njegov cimer, Kevin (Jon Stewart), otputovao je u inozemstvo bez naznaka skorog povratka. Kada se na Sonnyjevim vratima pojavi šestogodišnji Julian (Cole/Dylan Sprouse), Sonny u njemu vidi nadu za iskupljenje - pokazat će djevojci da može biti odgovorna osoba. Naravno, biti otac nestašnom šestogodišnjaku, daleko je od jednostavna zadatka...Slično pokušajima Jima Carreyja da se afirmira izvan matičnog žanra komedije, tako je i Adam Sandler u "Tati od formata" pokušao ostaviti ponešto drugačiji dojam od tipičnih provokatorskih uloga. Sandlerova genijalnost vidljiva je u svakom trenutku ove odlične komedije koja na domišljat način spaja humor i melodramu. Humor u filmu prilagođen je svim uzrastima, iako će posebno oduševiti najmlađe, ali i ponekog "neozbiljnog" roditelja. Film je režirao renomirani Dennis Dugan, filmaš s mnogo kvalitetnih serija u rezimeu, a posebno treba istaknuti "Ally McBeal" i "Chicago Hope". U manjoj ulozi pojavljuje se legendarni Steve Buscemi ("Fargo"), a Sandlerovu djevojku glumi lijepa Kristy Swanson ("Buffy").

Naravno, biti otac nestašnom šestogodišnjaku, daleko je od jednostavna zadatka...Slično pokušajima Jima Carreyja da se afirmira izvan matičnog žanra komedije, tako je i Adam Sandler u "Tati od formata" pokušao ostaviti ponešto drugačiji dojam od tipičnih provokatorskih uloga. Sandlerova genijalnost vidljiva je u svakom trenutku ove odlične komedije koja na domišljat način spaja humor i melodramu. Humor u filmu prilagođen je svim uzrastima, iako će posebno oduševiti najmlađe, ali i ponekog "neozbiljnog" roditelja. Film je režirao renomirani Dennis Dugan, filmaš s mnogo kvalitetnih serija u rezimeu, a posebno treba istaknuti "Ally McBeal" i "Chicago Hope". U manjoj ulozi pojavljuje se legendarni Steve Buscemi ("Fargo"), a Sandlerovu djevojku glumi lijepa Kristy Swanson ("Buffy").

programme.title: Ljeto ’72. film
programme.desc: Diplomirani student, 22-godišnji Billy Mitchell, na rubu ulaska u visoko društvo, otkriva da mu se planovi mijenjaju kad se zaljubi u pacijenticu s poremećajem višestruke osobnosti u očevoj mentalnoj ustanovi.

Stvari postanu neugodne i postanu još gore. Guido se sada mora iskupiti prije nego što bude razotkriven i ubijen, ili još gore, deportiran.

programme.desc: Međunarodna akcijska zvijezda Jackie Chan pozvan je na ceremoniju posvojenja rijetke bebe pande, ali nakon što međunarodni kriminalni sindikat pokuša oteti medvjeda, Jackie ga mora spasiti koristeći svoje kaskaderske vještine.

programme.title: Rezultat: Mjuzikl na ledu, film
programme.desc: 17-godišnji Farley je vodio zaštićeni život, odrastao na dijeti školovanja kod kuće, organskog života i odlazaka u umjetničku galeriju. Na užas svojih roditelja, Farley voli igrati hokej s lokalnom djecom. Na njihovu još veću nesreću, Farleyja je zapazio i angažirao vlasnik juniorske lige, gdje on odmah postaje zvijezda. Ali Farley otkriva da slava zvijezda ima svoju cijenu - uključujući i očekivanje borbe na ledu. Dodajte tome odnos s najboljim prijateljem i Farley se nađe u situaciji kad se počne gubiti.

programme.title: Na tajnom zadatku, film
programme.desc: Molly je tinejđerica koja radi sa svojim ocem, umirovljenim policajcem. FBI želi od nje da motri kćer čovjeka koji će svjedočiti protiv kriminala, stoga je šalju na fakultet koji njegova kćer pohađa. Dok se Molly pokušava uklopiti i budno motriti svoju metu, nastojiti otkriti pojavljuje li se netko tko se ne predstavlja svojim punim identitetom.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni, film
programme.desc: Kad ga izbace iz stana, prisiljen je spavati na ulici, no George zatraži utočište u bolnici Bellevue, prihvatnom centaru za beskućnike na Mahnattanu, gdje mu prijateljstvo s još jednim korisnikom centra pomogne da popravi svoj odnos s kćeri.

programme.title: To je život, film
programme.desc: Kad mladi par iz New Yorka prijeđe iz studentske ljubavi u brak i rođenje prvog djeteta, neočekivani preokreti na njihovu putovanju stvore odjeke kroz kontinente i živote. Redatelj i pisac Dan Fogelman („To smo mi) ispituje opasnosti i nagrade svakodnevnog života u multigeneracijskoj sagi u kojoj nastupa međunarodni ansambl među kojima su Oscar Isaac, Olivia Wilde, Antonio Banderas, Annette Bening, Olivia Cooke, Sergio Peris-Mencheta, Laia Costa, Alex Monner i Mandy Patinkin. Smješten u New Yorku i u Carmoni u Španjolskoj, film slavi ljudsko stanje i sve njegove komplikacije s humorom, dirljivošću i ljubavlju.

programme.title: Usponi i padovi, film
programme.desc: Između propalog stand-up komičara iz L. A.-a, prisiljenog preseliti se natrag kući na istočni Long Island podvijenog repa - i tragično manjkavog, ali šarmantnog i karizmatičnog dermatologa alkoholičara stvori se neobično prijateljstvo. Otkrivajući da su srodne duše, jedan drugome pomaže pronaći iscjeljenje, uz samopouzdanje da se suoče s „neuspjesima" u svojim životima.

programme.title: Bezbožno trojstvo, film
programme.desc: 1870-ih, u trenucima prije pogubljenja, Isaac Broadway daje svom otuđenom sinu Henryju nemoguć zadatak: ubiti čovjeka koji mu je smjestio zločin koji nije počinio. Henry putuje u Trinity, gdje ga neočekivani događaji zadrže u gradu i ostane uhvaćen između Gabriela Dovea, uglednog novog šerifa grada i tajanstvene figure po imenu St. Christopher.

programme.title: Utroje sa žigolom, film
programme.desc: Komedija o tome kako je Fioravante postao profesionalni don Juan da pomogne prijatelju u besparici. Murry (W. Allen) je vlasnik knjižare koja je propala i prisiljen je napustiti obiteljski posao. Njegova bogata dermatologica dr. Parker (S. Stone) spomenula mu je da ona i njezina partnerica traže muškarca za ménage à trois pa je Murry predložio svojem prijatelju i bivšem zaposleniku Fioravanteu (J. Turturro) da krene u posao sa ženama, a on će mu biti svodnik... Glumac John Torturro za ovu je komediju napisao scenarij i bio je redatelj što i nije tako rijetka pojava u životu ovog svestranog umjetnika. Uz njega koji tumači ulogu Fioravantea nastupaju još zvijezde kao što su Woody Allen i Sharon Stone, zatim atraktivna Sofia Vergera i francuska pjevačica, model i glumica Vanessa Paradis.

programme.title: 30 dana, film
programme.desc: Politička priča o vremenu kad je vlada SAD-a ponovno uvela novačenje. Trojica prijatelja, uspješni odvjetnik George (Chris Klein), vozač taksija Dixon (Jon Bernthal) i nesigurni pisac Feller (Elijah Wood) imaju samo 30 dana da se jave na dužnost. Film istražuje njihovu emocionalnu bitku o napuštanju sigurnih života i odlazak u krvavi rat. Na kraju će se svatko od njih suprotstaviti vlastitim vjerovanjima u hrabrost, dužnost, ljubav, prijateljstvo i čast.

programme.title: Opoziv, film
programme.desc: Veliki Wesley Snipes (Blade!) glumi Huntera u ovom filmu Maura Borellia (The Goshtmaker). U filmu nastupaju i RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) i Hannah Rose May (Ballers). Film koji priča priču o pet prijatelja koji odsjedaju u kući na udaljenom jezeru, sa željom da se dobro provedu. Nisu ni svjesni da je Zemlja pod napadom izvanzemaljaca i masovnih otmica. Režiser Borelli je bivši suradnik Tima Burtona i filmski illustrator za filmove poput Pirata s Kariba i Kapetana America. "Recall" će također biti snimljen za novi Barcov Espace trostruki, panoramski kazališni format, koji u potpunosti okružuje publiku i nudi im vrhunski doživljaj kina. Dio filma će također biti snimljen u virtualnoj stvarnosti.

programme.title: Avanture neustrašivog Teda, film
programme.desc: Tadeo Jones, svima poznatiji kao Ted, Španjolac je s američkom adresom. Životni put odveo ga je u Chicago gdje je postao poznati arheolog. Da, ali samo u snovima! Ted, naime, radi kao građevinski radnik u jednoj tvrtki sve dok jednog dana ne dobije otkaz jer, umjesto da se primio čekića, on je sanjario o poslu arheologa. Pomoć odluči potražiti kod svog prijatelja, poznatog istraživača, profesora Humberta. Situacija se krene neočekivano razvijati kad profesor doživi nesreću, a Ted preuzima njegovo mjesto i odlazi u ekspediciju u Peru. Tedu će od velike pomoći biti njegov najbolji prijatelj, psić Jeff, a misija mu je spasiti mitski Izgubljeni grad Inka.

programme.title: Pennyna sjena, film
programme.desc: Jašući tijekom odmora na otoku Ameland, djevojka nalazi opasnog konja, koji nema povjerenja u ljude. Kako bi dokazala da konj uopće nije opasan, ona potajno navikava konja na povjerenje ljudima.

programme.title: Djeca bez granica, film
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste i Becca su tri nevjerojatna izopćenika iz srednje škole koji formiraju klub u napuštenom kazalištu. Tamo upoznaju Charlieja (Bill Cobbs, Noć u muzeju), beskućnika koji dijeli njihovu strast prema glazbenom kazalištu. Kad je predviđeno rušenje kazališta, tinejdžeri ga odluče spasiti modernom izvedbom Shakespeareove 'Puno buke ni oko čega'. Usput, grupa uči odnositi se prema drugima s poštovanjem i braniti svoja uvjerenja. Kanal Dove je odobrio ovaj film, u kojem nastupa i Lee Meriwether, nominiran za Emmy i Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Projekt dinosaur, film
programme.desc: Britanska ekspedicija koja okuplja glavnog istraživača Jonathana Marchanta, njegovog asistenta, doktora i televizijsku ekipu, putuje u Kongo kako bi pronašla dokaze o postojanju dinosaura. Lokalni vodič i pilot helikoptera pridružuju se timu te se grupa zaputi u džunglu. Tijekom putovanja, oni pronalaze slijepog putnika u helikopteru, Jonathanovog sina. Uskoro helikopter napadaju leteća bića te on pada u džunglu na početku poslijednjeg putovanja Jonathana Merchanta i njegova sina.

programme.title: Maraton, film
programme.desc: Mlađi zaposlenik Youssoef predlaže da četvorica ljudi sudjeluju u maratonu i pronađu sponzora. Oni pristaju i Youssoef im postaje trener. No, isprva treninzi nalikuju sprdnji. Stanje ljudi koji puše, piju, jedu kolače i uglavnom provode dane u kartanju, jednostavno je odvratno. Ni kućne prilike im nisu sjajne. Svi imaju vlastite probleme. Unatoč nadahnjujućem ohrabrivanju trenera Youssoefa, oni jednostavno nisu u stanju pratiti gusti raspored treninga. Prvi pravi ispit, utrka u Amsterdamu, pretvara se u potpunu katastrofu. Nakon Youssoefove 'jezikove juhe', dečki se trgnu i postanu skoro fanatični. Međutim, trenirajući za maraton, postaju svjesni kako je u pitanju mnogo više od pukog zadržavanja garaže...

programme.title: Ljubav u oblacima, film
programme.desc: Novinarka Brooklyn odlazi na Balloon Fiestu kako bi upoznala pilota balona Jareda, koji organizira romantične letove, ali sam je zatvoren za ljubav.

programme.title: Nas dvojica, film
programme.desc: Jean-Christian Ranu (Daniel Auteuil) je malo ekscentričan računovođa koji živi iz dana u dan. Gilles Gabriel (Alain Chabat) je, zauzvrat, pjevač pop glazbe, koji je jednom imao svojih pet minuta. Nitko nikada ne bi očekivao da se životi ove dvojice vrlo različitih ljudi mogu odjednom povezati. Zvijezda se sada priprema za svoj veliki povratak na scenu, ali naivni planovi naglo se prekidaju kad udara Rana automobilom. Nakon oporavljanja žrtva s užasom otkriva da se u njegovoj glavi pojavio neki drugi glas. Ispostavlja se da je Gabriel umro i na neobjašnjiv način se naselio u umu knjigovođe. Od tog vremena, Ranu postaje dvije osobe u jednom tijelu ...

programme.title: Charliejevi anđeli, film
programme.desc: Natalie (Cameron Diaz), Dylan (Drew Barrymore) i Alex (Lucy Liu), znane i kao "Charliejevi anđeli", pripadnice su neobične detektivske agencije. Njihova nova zadaća pronalazak je elektronskog genija Knoxa (Sam Rockwell), čiji je nestanak prijavila njegova najbolja prijateljica Vivian (Kelly Lynch). Najsumnjiviji je Knoxov glavni rival, magnat Corwin (Tim Curry), ali anđeli se moraju obračunati i s poremećenim ubojicom koji im stoji na putu...

programme.title: Ukradena priča, film
programme.desc: Kad Rory Jansen (Bradley Cooper) objavi svoj prvi roman, to je onaj rijedak, jedinstveni događaj što literarni svijet i javnost obori s nogu. Prijatelji ga zdušno preporučuju, kritika diže u nebesa i jednostavno je posvuda; od književnih klubova, aviona do sveučilišnih kampusa. Svježinom glasa i mudrošću koja se čini nekako bezvremenskom, Rory postaje instant zvijezda na literarnom nebu. Karizmatičan, talentiran, inteligentan, čini se da mladi autor ima sve: divan život, krasnu suprugu (Zoë Saldana), svijet mu je pod nogama- i sve to zbog njegovih riječi. Ali čije su to riječi? I na koncu, čija je priča? Na vrhuncu slave, tajanstveni starac (Jeremy Irons) dođe Roryju i suoči ga s činjenicom da je zapravo on autor romana. Starac prebrojava prelijepe, ali tragične uspomene iz svoje mladosti u Parizu nakon II. Svjetskog rata, na temelju kojih je roman i nastao. Vidjevši da je netko drugi platio cijenu za istinu i viziju priča, Rory preispituje svoju kreativnost, ambiciju i moralni izbor koji je učinio na milost i nemilost ovih poriva. Napisana kao priča u priči i Roryjev život je proizvod mašte. Iza svega stoji stvarni literarni mag, Clay Hammond (Dennis Quaid.) Prekrasna i lukava studentica (Olivia Wilde) navela ga je na priču o stvarnom značenju njegova romana,pri čemu si ne može pomoći sakriti vezu između priče i vlastite tajnovite prošlosti.

programme.title: Pijani od ljubavi, film
programme.desc: Barry Egan (Adam Sandler) vodi vlastiti posao, no neprestano ga progoni njegovih sedam sestara, pa katkad postane malčice nasilan. Jednog čudnog jutra na ulici susretne neobičnu mladu ženu Lena Leonard (Emily Watson), koja ga zamoli za pomoć oko automobila. Nekoliko dana poslije ponovno se susreću i čini se da među njima postoji iskra, no pitanje je da li mogu li preživjeti njegov naizgled previše kompliciran život...

programme.title: Bezbožnik: ispovijest serijskog ubojice, film
programme.desc: Film o kriminalnoj misteriji temeljen na stvarnim transkriptima razgovora između agenta FBI-ja Billa Hagmaiera i notornog serijskog ubojice Teda Bundyja tijekom njegovih posljednjih godina na smrtnom rešetku. Film istražuje njihov složen odnos, pri čemu Bundy otkriva intimne detalje svog života i zločina Hagmaieru. Kako Hagmaier dublje uranja u Bundyjevu psihu, suočava se s moralnim i psihološkim implikacijama njihovih interakcija. Radnja kulminira Bundyjevim pogubljenjem usred medijskog ludila, ostavljajući dubok utisak na Hagmaiera.

programme.title: Mjesečina, film
programme.desc: Kad poznata odvjetnica Louise sazna da je muž Ian nakon 13 godina braka namjerava ostaviti zbog djevojke u dvadesetim godinama, impulzivno se odlučuje na drastične mjere. Zarobljuje Iana u njihovoj ladanjskoj kući te ga ne želi pustiti sve dok ne rasprave probleme. On se, dakako, opire, a sve kreće po zlu kad se u kući pojavi provalnik zbog kojeg će svi morati otkriti i priznati prave osjećaje.

programme.title: Tajni agent, film
programme.desc: Britanski tajni agent Ewan (Sean Bean) na tragu je terorističkoj ćeliji iz Londona, posvećenoj borbi protiv zapadnog svijeta. Ewanov cilj je uloviti anonimnog islamskog radikala Asha (Abhin Galeya), kojeg je teško prepoznati i privesti jer nitko ne zna kako izgleda. I dok se službe nacionalne sigurnosti utrkuju s vremenom kako bi pronašle teroriste, Ewanu je posve jasno da će, ukoliko ne zaustavi radikala, posljedice za zapadnu civilizaciju biti dalekosežne i nemjerljive.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Sailing To Tokyo
programme.desc: This magazine is the story of Olympic Sailing, as the world’s best strive to compete on the world’s greatest sports stage and claim their medals at the Olympic Games. Dedicated to Olympic sailing, Sailing to Tokyo follows the long journey and defining moments in athletes’ careers as they dream to make Olympic history.

programme.title: 4 Deserts Race
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of the 4 Deserts Race Series, the only international ultramarathon series which mixes local culture with trail running. The 4 Deserts Race Series is widely recognized as one of the most prestigious outdoor running series in the world. It is made up of 4 of the most iconic and toughest races in the world - the Sahara Race in Egypt and Namibia, the Gobi March between China and Mongolia, the Atacama Crossing in Chile and The Last Desert in Antarctica. Competitors traverse 250 kilometers in seven days over rough country terrain with only a place in a tent and water provided and support from the very best operational and medical teams provided. Through this documentary, we will travel to two destinations of the 2017 4 Deserts race calendar; China for the Gobi March in the great Gobi Desert and Chile for the Atacama Crossing in the Atacama Desert, an area of extraordinary beauty and astounding natural wonders.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Audi Winter Games 2018
programme.desc: Stunning scenery, world’s best talent and Kiwi hospitality is set to be showcased to a global audience with Winter Games New Zealand carrying out a diverse event yet again. Winter Olympic, Paralympic and X Games stars are heading to New Zealand’s Southern Alps once again for the first major winter sports championships of the season. They compete for glory in varied sports such as freestyle skiing, snowboarding, alpine skiing, cross-country skiing and curling. The Winter Games New Zealand are one of the world’s top five winter sports competitions and the only one in the southern hemisphere. They are also New Zealand’s largest recurring sports event. It’s a uniquely Kiwi experience that athletes, coaches, judges and spectators all rave about. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, sporting action and festival fun with live acts and DJs - host towns Queenstown and Wanaka look forward to the biggest party on southern snow!

programme.title: Xterra Adventures
programme.desc: XTERRA is the world’s premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part survival of the fittest. The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain’s premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense ‘flash stage’, featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km ‘finisher’ stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo’s unforgettable single-track trail. Riders choose their risks to secure an advantage, all the time fully conscious that one mistake navigating the rocky trails means their race is over. programme.desc: Film noir. Christopher Cross, blagajnik (E. G. Robinson) i slikar amater u nesretnom je braku. Kada se zaljubi u privlačnu Kitty (J. Bennett) počinju ozbiljni problemi: ona ga, uz pomoć svojeg ljubavnika Johnnyja (D. Duryea), odluči iskoristiti pa Cross uzima novac od svoje žene i šefa da bi zadovoljio njezine prohtjeve. U ovom filmu, Fritz Lang do vrhunca u svojem američkom opusu dovodi težnju prema fantazmagoričnim ugođajima koje postiže ritmičkim izmjenjivanjem svjetla i sjene, klaustrofobičnim funkcioniranjem okvira te uporabom zvukova u pozadini, dok se posljednji kadrovi junaka izgubljenog u masi, koja postupno nestaje ostavljajući njega samog u kadru, tumače kao efektna slika suvremenog urbanog otuđenja.
